name: Una Carta en Blanco
source:
Have you ever had a secret you didn't want anyone to know about? This game tells the story of Kuro, a boy who was branded a delinquent due to an accident he was accused of at school. After that event, everyone in his class stopped talking to him, but his luck got worse when a classmate discovered a secret he was hiding in one of his notebooks. What can Kuro do to prevent his secret from being revealed?
